what_it_is.prose: Ananth Technologies is an Indian space and defence company headquartered in Hyderabad, founded in 1992 by Dr Subba Rao Pavuluri. Supplies mission-critical electronic systems for satellites, launch vehicles and missiles. 30+ year ISRO partnership: supplied control electronics modules for ISRO's CMS-3 satellite; delivered onboard electronics & satellite integration support across all 3 lunar missions (Chandrayaan-1, -2, -3). SpaDeX Target and Chaser satellites were completely assembled, integrated, and tested at Ananth's Bengaluru facility (Aerospace Park, Devanahalli, opened Feb 2020). Manufactured 107 satellites and 87 launch vehicles with 100% success rate. Building AnanthSat-1 — India's first privately developed communication satellite. MoU with BEL (Aug 2026) to jointly develop indigenous systems for missiles, radars, satellites and navigation.
